trigger: The preregistered monolithic exact-certificate run for rank 273 exceeded the execution window and produced no result file.

execution_partition.core: For each rank, execute the full exact denominator/target/non-target positivity certificate as one core job.
execution_partition.direct: Execute each predeclared exact rational direct-regression probe as a separate job. Full predictions use five probes; single-boundary predictions use four probes.
execution_partition.aggregation: A rank is mathematically resolved only if core is SUPPORT and every required direct probe is SUPPORT. No rank may be omitted or replaced.

note: This changes execution granularity only; it does not retroactively complete any full-atlas shard.
